1) we propose a method to generate interaction test cases for the verification of feature interaction scenarios in mobile phone systems; 2) we show that it is possible to generate interaction test case scenarios using use cases as a specification language and a behavioral model as an intermediate representation; and 3) we present a strategy for the generation of interaction test cases from the model.

(1) the use case specification can be extended to specify feature interaction requirements; (2) a behavioral model can be generated from such specification; (3) the behavioral model can be used to generate test cases that aim to test the feature interactions; and (4) the generated test cases can be used to test the feature interaction requirements.

(1) use case diagrams are an appropriate way for specifying feature interaction requirements in a way that is easily understood by both developers and testers; (2) a behavioral model can be automatically generated from the use case diagram; and (3) test cases for feature interactions can be generated from the behavioral model.
